title: Global Advocacy and Legal Counsel selects Legora after a structured evaluation of AI platforms
summary: Following a review of multiple platforms by its own AI Task Force, the Dubai-headquartered law firm is now using Legora for case file review, drafting, Arabic-to-English translation and legal research, under an internal AI policy that keeps lawyer oversight and client confidentiality in place.
body_markdown:
Following a review of multiple platforms by its own AI Task Force, the Dubai-headquartered law firm is now using Legora for case file review, drafting, Arabic-to-English translation and legal research, under an internal AI policy that keeps lawyer oversight and client confidentiality in place.


Legora, the agentic operating system for legal professionals, today announced that Global Advocacy and Legal Counsel ("Global") has selected Legora following a rigorous review and testing of multiple AI platforms. Global's lawyers are now using Legora across a range of legal and operational workflows.


Before choosing a platform, Global set up an internal AI Task Force to test the options on practical legal work. It also developed an internal AI policy giving users clear guidance on client confidentiality, lawyer oversight and responsible use.


Ali Al Hashimi, Global's Regional Managing Partner, **** said: "Our approach was not simply to adopt AI, but to understand how it could be introduced responsibly and where it could genuinely support our lawyers and clients. We evaluated a number of platforms, established appropriate internal governance and tested the technology against practical legal use cases. Legora stood out as the right fit for our teams and the way we want to use AI to enhance our legal work."


Global's lawyers are using Legora for case file and document review, preparing chronologies, drafting and refining legal work, Arabic-to-English translation, matter tracking and billing support. Teams also use it to analyse and compare opponents' submissions to identify differences and inconsistencies, proofread and refine draft agreements, review and align contractual provisions and defined terms, and consolidate and organise references and authorities in legal research.


Leonard Schreij, VP Revenue EMEA at Legora, said: "Translating documents from Arabic, checking one submission against another, aligning defined terms across an agreement: this is where lawyers lose hours. Global's teams can now spend those hours on judgment and advice, and the aim is faster work at lower cost for their clients. That is the impact we want to see everywhere we work."


Global will continue to work with Legora to extend its use across the practice, focusing on efficiency in legal service delivery and lower costs for the firm and its clients, while keeping professional judgment, oversight and client confidentiality at the centre.


**About Global Advocacy and Legal Counsel**
Global Advocacy and Legal Counsel is a Dubai-headquartered law firm with offices in Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah, Muscat and Amman. It advises local, regional and international clients on litigation, arbitration, banking and finance, and corporate and commercial matters.


**About Legora**
Legora is the agentic operating system for legal work, supporting lawyers in research, review, and drafting across complex matters. It is used by more than 150,000 legal professionals at more than 2,500 leading law firms and in-house legal teams across over 80 markets.
